description: Converts svelte-check output into GitLab Code Quality reports, GitHub Actions annotations and SARIF for GitHub code scanning
rules: Pipe svelte-check with `--output machine-verbose` into the reporter: `svelte-check --output machine-verbose | svelte-check-reporter ...`. Other svelte-check output modes are rejected.
`--output-file <path>` is required with `--format gitlab` (the default) and `--format sarif`, and not allowed with `--format github`, which prints annotations to the log.
On GitHub, use either `--format github` (annotations) or `--format sarif` (code scanning), not both: each problem would show twice.
For GitLab, declare the file under `artifacts: reports: codequality` with `when: always`, and run the job on the target branch too, so GitLab can compare reports.

For code scanning, upload the SARIF file with `github/codeql-action/upload-sarif` under `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`, give the job `security-events: write`, and also run it on pushes to the default branch.
In SvelteKit projects, run `svelte-kit sync` before svelte-check, and run the command from the repository root so file paths match.
Exit codes: 0 no errors (warnings alone pass), 1 svelte-check errors, 2 unusable input or options.
